external_model.name: GLM-5.3
external_model.scope: Sanitized About-only HTML/CSS, Kotlin, SwiftUI and ArkTS source; no execution or screenshot assessment

adjudications.finding: Android should disclose a browser-triggered worker pause
adjudications.reason: Android activity pause only stops the UI refresh callback; NodeService remains a foreground service. The scoped model packet did not include the full service lifecycle.

adjudications.finding: iOS failed-link feedback may be below the visible scroll area
adjudications.reason: Failure handling exists, but presenting an alert or feedback nearer the activated link would improve discoverability.

adjudications.finding: Mobile references omit the desktop Wiki link
adjudications.reason: Mobile still supplies repository, official downloads, architecture, research, third-party notices and license references required by the brief.
The links are fixed public HTTPS references intended for a browsable URL handler; failure is caught.

adjudications.finding: Very narrow desktop reference grid may be dense
adjudications.reason: The375px view is readable with no overflow. Smaller widths and enlarged fonts were not qualified.

adjudications.finding: Language changes may overwrite the installed host version
adjudications.reason: Italian and Simplified Chinese switches retained the runtime0.3.0 version.

limitations: GLM review is source-only; it did not execute code or inspect screenshots.
Native Android/iOS physical-device UI, large fonts and screen readers were not tested in this review.
HarmonyOS remains an uncompiled source candidate.
Compilation, signing and inference performance are separate qualification scopes.
